tasks.title: Restore responsive homepage board layout
tasks.description: Refactor the homepage board shell so the desktop Kanban renders as a horizontal row of stage columns at `md+` widths while preserving the existing query-state and sort behavior. Keep the mobile single-stage board model intact and adjust column presentation so Done/history is visually quieter than active work without removing it.
acceptanceCriteria: At `md+` widths, the homepage renders stage columns side by side in a horizontal board container instead of a vertical stack
Desktop sort and existing board query state still apply consistently across all visible stage columns
The Done column remains available but uses lower-emphasis presentation than active columns
Mobile continues to render a single-stage board view rather than the desktop multi-column layout
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use the existing StageColumn sizing contract; fix the container direction instead of redesigning the board with a new layout system.

tasks.title: Add homepage needs-attention summary
tasks.description: Introduce a homepage-specific attention derivation and render a compact `Needs attention` summary above the board. The summary should translate existing issue and agent fields into user-action labels such as `Approval needed`, `Integration failed`, `Interrupted`, `Needs action`, and `Not merged`, with short secondary context when available.
acceptanceCriteria: The homepage shows a `Needs attention` summary above the board when actionable items exist
Summary items are derived from existing issue/agent fields and include approval-awaiting, interrupted, blocked or needs-action, integrate-failed, and done-but-not-merged cases when present
Primary labels use user-action wording such as `Approval needed`, `Integration failed`, `Interrupted`, and `Not merged` rather than raw internal state names
Selecting a summary item takes the user to the relevant issue detail page without removing existing board navigation
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the attention mapping in a focused helper instead of duplicating or overloading IssueCard badge logic.

tasks.title: Implement compact full-label filter controls
tasks.description: Replace the current first-eight-label filter bar with a compact control surface that preserves URL-backed search, priority, labels, and sort while making every project label reachable. On mobile, keep search and active filter state immediately visible and collapse secondary controls so issue content remains in the first screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Label filtering no longer depends on `allLabels.slice(0, 8)` and users can reach every label returned by `/api/labels`
Users can select a label that would previously have been hidden beyond the first eight visible labels
The homepage keeps URL-backed search, priority, label, and sort state behavior introduced in #198
On mobile, search and active filters remain visible while secondary controls are compact or collapsible enough that issue content appears in the first screen
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer a lightweight expandable or searchable label control that keeps selected labels visible when collapsed.

tasks.title: Add homepage regression coverage for layout and filter reachability
tasks.description: Extend component-level homepage tests so future regressions fail when desktop columns become vertically stacked or when labels beyond the first eight become unreachable again. Cover the decision-first summary, the desktop board container contract, and a hidden-label filtering path that proves the board updates correctly after selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests fail if the desktop homepage board container no longer renders with a horizontal multi-column contract at `md+` widths
Tests verify the homepage can render a `Needs attention` summary item with user-action wording from representative issue data
Tests verify a label beyond the first eight available labels is discoverable/selectable and updates filtered board counts
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/web/src/components/kanban-board-query.test.tsx and related Web UI homepage tests
tasks.notes: Prefer stable DOM contracts or test ids over brittle screenshot assertions.
